question: Bihu is a folk music and dance form associated with which Indian state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Bihu** is the most celebrated folk music and dance form of **Assam**, symbolizing the cultural identity of the Assamese people.
 
• It is performed during the **Rongali Bihu** festival, which marks the Assamese New Year and the arrival of spring.
 
• The dance is characterized by brisk steps, rapid hand movements, and vibrant costumes.
 
• Musical instruments such as the **dhol** (drum), **pepa** (buffalo horn pipe), and **gagana** (a reed instrument) are commonly used in Bihu performances.
 
• Bihu is not just a dance but a celebration of Assam’s agrarian roots, as it is closely linked to the harvest season.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Types of Bihu:** There are three major types of Bihu celebrated in Assam – Rongali (Bohag) Bihu, Kongali (Kati) Bihu, and Bhogali (Magh) Bihu, each corresponding to different agricultural cycles.
 
• **Rongali Bihu:** This is the most popular form of Bihu, celebrated in April, marking the Assamese New Year and the sowing season.
 
• **Traditional Attire:** During Bihu performances, women wear traditional Assamese attire called **Mekhela Chador**, while men wear **Dhoti and Gamosa**.
 
• **UNESCO Recognition:** Bihu dance has gained international recognition and is often performed at global cultural festivals to represent India’s rich heritage.
 
• **Folk Significance:** Beyond entertainment, Bihu dance serves as a platform to express joy, unity, and gratitude towards nature and the harvest.
